privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Please read carefully how we handle your personal information.
privacy.intro_body: Economic Group may seek certain information about you to assist us in servicing your personalized home page and account. With regard to such personal data, we assure all clients of the following:
privacy.effort_body: We will make every effort to safeguard your privacy while using the Economic Group web site.
privacy.collection_body: We will not collect personal information unless it is specifically and willingly provided but the collection of such data may be a requirement of delivering certain services and information requested by you.
privacy.use_body: Your personal data helps us provide additional information on products, services and content that may be of interest to you. If you do not wish to receive such information, please contact us via our website “Contact Us”.
privacy.correspondence_body1: If you correspond with us via e-mail, we may keep a copy for internal use.
privacy.correspondence_body2: A record of communications between you and Economic Group may be necessary to comply with legal and/or regulatory requirements.
privacy.sharing_body1: We do not sell personal information to third parties.
privacy.sharing_body2: We only share personal information if obliged to by law or when, subject to your consent, you request a particular service requiring such disclosure.
privacy.security_body1: We protect your personal information by placing it in a secure segment of our website, which is why you need a unique User Name and Password to access your account. Clients are responsible for keeping their passwords safe and must ensure they are not entrusted to, or shared with anyone else.
privacy.security_body2: All personal and sensitive information is encrypted, both in transit and in storage, to prevent unauthorized access.
privacy.security_body3: A firewall system also prevents unauthorized back and front office access to sensitive information.
privacy.security_body4: Total Virus Defense software rigorously scans all information entering and leaving our system.
privacy.links_body: Economic Group provides links to other websites but is not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those sites.
